name: Aries Grammar
description: Defines Aries-compatible modifier forms, targets, and restrictions.

targetCompatibility.planet: Modify how the planetary verb begins, proceeds, or asserts direction.
targetCompatibility.angle: Modify how the reference-frame function establishes entry or direction.
targetCompatibility.node: Modify how consolidation or development occurs through initiation.
targetCompatibility.chiron: Modify how adaptation begins or tests a new method.

rules: Resolve the target function before selecting Aries modifiers.
Use speed only where target compatibility permits it.
Autonomy must not be rendered as isolation.
First-move priority does not imply leadership.
